```yaml
name: Test BPFtrace

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test-helloworld:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        components: rustc, cargo, clippy

    - name: Build helloworld project in debug mode
      run: cargo build --manifest-path examples/helloworld/Cargo.toml --debug

    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists
      run: nm examples/helloworld/target/debug/helloworld | grep ' T _ZN10helloworld5helloE'

    - name: Run helloworld binary
      run: ./examples/helloworld/target/debug/helloworld

  build-and-test-args:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        components: rustc, cargo, clippy

    - name: Build args project in debug mode
      run: cargo build --manifest-path examples/args/Cargo.toml --debug

    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists
      run: nm examples/args/target/debug/args | grep ' T _ZN10helloworld5helloE'

    - name: Run args binary
      run: ./examples/args/target/debug/args

  bpftrace-attach-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        components: rustc, cargo, clippy

    - name: Build helloworld project in debug mode
      run: cargo build --manifest-path examples/helloworld/Cargo.toml --debug

    - name: Install bpftrace
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace

    - name: Attach bpftrace to helloworld binary
      run: |
        echo 'uprobe:/path/to/examples/helloworld/target/debug/helloworld:hello { printf("Hello world\n"); }' | sudo bpftrace -
```
